{{Quote|There is no one in the Outer Rim as reliable as you, my little mastmot.|Lady Valarian using ''mastmot'' as a term of endearment|<ref name="SWG:LV">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Lady Valarian|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Mastmots''' (a.k.a. '''motmots''' in some [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] dialects) were massive, thick-furred, quadrupedal [[ungulate]]s with two nasal horns, two long tusks, long ears, and a dorsal hump over the shoulders.

Herd-dwelling herbivores, they lived on the harsh, frigid world of [[Toola/Legends|Toola]]. The indigenous [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] people hunted the mastmots, using the body parts for food, clothing, shelter, and tools. Their tusks were often made into necklaces.<ref name="Let Us Prey: The Whiphid's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=Let Us Prey: The Whiphid's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>

The mastmots could be domesticated as riding mounts, and were so used by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Keller (clone commander)|Keller's]] [[Keller's unit|forces]] on Toola during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]].
